MAGPlot 2.0 example tables

Source: R/data.R
magp_example.Rd

A small synthetic example of MAGPlot 2.0's 17 tables, built from magp_spec(): every table and column of the data dictionary, each column of the R class its type maps to, and made-up values that come from no delivery. The help pages' examples use it.

Usage

magp_example

Format

A named list of 17 data.tables, one per dictionary table, in the dictionary's order (magp_contributors to magp_tally_trees), each with the dictionary's columns in its order. It has two contributors, each with two datasets; every key points to a row of its parent table, and every coded column holds a code from its list. The list and each table carry the attribute gpq_fixture = TRUE, which marks synthetic data. There is no magp_meta table.

Changing a table by reference (:= or data.table::set()) can change the example for the rest of the session; take a copy with data.table::copy() first.

Source

Built by data-raw/build_magp_example.R in the package's source repository.

Examples

names(magp_example)
#>  [1] "magp_contributors"  "magp_datasets"      "magp_sites"        
#>  [4] "magp_site_dist"     "magp_site_treat"    "magp_site_visits"  
#>  [7] "magp_plots"         "magp_subplots"      "magp_designs"      
#> [10] "magp_design_frames" "magp_plot_meas"     "magp_subplot_meas" 
#> [13] "magp_trees"         "magp_tree_meas"     "magp_tree_cond"    
#> [16] "magp_tree_age"      "magp_tally_trees"  
magp_example$magp_plots
